description: QIF authoring-template negative fixture corpus. Each file is an invalid package that a conformant verifier must reject with an error containing errorIncludes. Generated from tools/fixtures/authoring-template-cases.mjs; do not edit by hand.

negatives.rule: authoringTemplates must be an array
negatives.errorIncludes: authoringTemplates must be an array.

negatives.rule: instruction block lists prohibited claims
negatives.errorIncludes: INS-ATP-001 prohibitedClaims must include at least one claim.

negatives.rule: instruction does not treat checklist completion as quality
negatives.errorIncludes: INS-ATP-001 instructionText must not treat checklist completion as quality.

negatives.rule: input contract declares required fields
negatives.errorIncludes: INC-ATP-001 requiredFields must include at least one field.

negatives.rule: audience explanation contracts must be an array
negatives.errorIncludes: audienceExplanationContracts must be an array.

negatives.rule: audience explanation targets general public
negatives.errorIncludes: AEC-ATP-001 audienceLevel must be general-public.

negatives.rule: audience explanation lists terms to avoid without explanation
negatives.errorIncludes: AEC-ATP-001 termsToAvoidWithoutExplanation must include at least one term.

negatives.rule: audience explanation requires a diagram spec
negatives.errorIncludes: AEC-ATP-001 diagramSpecs must include at least one diagram spec.

negatives.rule: diagram text shows simple flow
negatives.errorIncludes: AEC-ATP-001 diagramText must show a simple flow using ->.

negatives.rule: template links audience explanation contract
negatives.errorIncludes: ATP-001 references missing audience explanation contract: AEC-NOPE-999

negatives.rule: diagram comprehension evidence must be an array
negatives.errorIncludes: diagramComprehensionEvidence must be an array.

negatives.rule: each explanation contract has diagram comprehension evidence
negatives.errorIncludes: AEC-ATP-001 must have at least one diagram comprehension evidence item.

negatives.rule: diagram comprehension evidence links explanation contract
negatives.errorIncludes: DCE-ATP-001 references missing audience explanation contract: AEC-NOPE-999

negatives.rule: diagram comprehension understood is boolean
negatives.errorIncludes: DCE-ATP-001 understood must be boolean.

negatives.rule: not-understood diagram evidence triggers governance
negatives.errorIncludes: DCE-ATP-001 not-understood diagram comprehension evidence requires governanceTriggerRefs.

negatives.rule: output contract targets supported package type
negatives.errorIncludes: OUC-ATP-001 targetPackageType is not supported: mystery-package

negatives.rule: output contract declares entity families
negatives.errorIncludes: OUC-ATP-001 requiredEntityFamilies must include at least one family.

negatives.rule: validation pipeline links output contract
negatives.errorIncludes: VPL-ATP-001 references missing output contract: OUC-NOPE-999

negatives.rule: validation pipeline uses local QIF validator
negatives.errorIncludes: VPL-ATP-001 validationCommand must call a local QIF validator.

negatives.rule: golden case declares acceptance criteria
negatives.errorIncludes: GCS-ATP-001 acceptanceCriteria must include at least one criterion.

negatives.rule: scoring rubric declares criteria
negatives.errorIncludes: SRB-ATP-001 criteria must include at least one criterion.

negatives.rule: template target package matches output contract
negatives.errorIncludes: ATP-001 targetPackageType must match output contract targetPackageType.

negatives.rule: agent run does not store hidden reasoning
negatives.errorIncludes: AAR-ATP-001 hiddenReasoningStored must not be true.

negatives.rule: pass result score meets rubric threshold
negatives.errorIncludes: CFR-ATP-001 pass verdict score is below rubric passThreshold.

negatives.rule: non-pass result triggers governance
negatives.errorIncludes: CFR-ATP-001 non-pass conformance result requires governanceTriggerRefs.

negatives.rule: verifier boundary avoids agent competence claim
negatives.errorIncludes: verifierBoundary must explicitly avoid claiming agent authoring competence.

negatives.rule: verifier boundary avoids universal user comprehension claim
negatives.errorIncludes: verifierBoundary must explicitly avoid claiming universal user comprehension.
